_about: The Pulpit Commentary (ed. H. D. M. Spence and Joseph S. Exell; first published London: Kegan Paul, Trench, 1880-1897), from Adam's Libronix inventory (Scholar's Library: Gold). Internet Archive OCR, raw, of Cornell's Funk & Wagnalls set (one Toronto copy for I Chronicles); each volume's book and volume number read from its second title page, 2026-11-03. Several volumes bind more than one book (e.g. Judges with Ruth, Ezra with Nehemiah and Esther); the row names the book on the volume's title page. Every contributor died long before 1930 and every printing is pre-1930, so US public domain. Added 2026-11-03 by lane A. No uids minted.
